properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 1 at 10:01AM PST until November 2 at 6:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Onshore winds this afternoon with maximum wind gusts 20
to 25 mph, combined with elevated surf of 3-6 ft, and an
afternoon high tide near 6.5 ft will result in minor tidal
overflow.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Through Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor tidal overflow and dangerous rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will decrease Sunday evening, but
elevated surf will continue Monday with high tides close to 6
ft. High tide 11/1 will occur around 2 PM and high tide 11/2
will occur around 3:30 PM. Tides are expected to increase for
the end of the week, with tides reaching 7 ft as early as
Friday. Tides will peak over the weekend into early next week
around 7.5 ft. Reminder, tides mentioned have been corrected to
reflect the current trends in actual tide observations.
properties.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

NWSheadline: BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY AFTERNOON
